chapters.title: Explore the Skull
chapters.prompt: Rotate the skull to the right to familiarize yourself with the skull model.

chapters.title: Identify the sagittal suture.
chapters.prompt: Skull sutures are fibrous joints between the bones of the skull that allow expansion during brain growth and later fuse into solid bone. Locate the suture between the two parietal bones called the sagittal suture.

chapters.title: Locate the external auditory meatus.
chapters.prompt: Rotate the skull and find the left ear canal.

chapters.title: Identify the lacrimal.
chapters.prompt: The lacrimal is the most fragile bone in the skull, and is part of the tear duct. Locate the left lacrimal.
chapters.hint: Remember, your left is different from the model's left!

chapters.title: Identify the palatine.
chapters.prompt: The palatine bone makes up the hard palette of the mouth. Locate the right palatine bone.

chapters.title: Identify the vomer.
chapters.prompt: The vomer is the blade-shaped bone found in the nasal cavity that divides this cavity into left and right sides. Find the vomer.

chapters.title: Dissect to view deep cranial bones.
chapters.prompt: Use the Dissect tool to remove the bones listed below. Be careful with your dissection - you only get 3 mistakes before the lesson resets!

chapters.title: Identify the sphenoid.
chapters.prompt: The sphenoid is a deep bone found in the anterior of the skull. Find the sphenoid.

chapters.title: Describe the sphenoid.
chapters.prompt: What living organism does the sphenoid look like to you?

chapters.title: Find the internal auditory meatus.
chapters.prompt: The internal auditory meatus is where the ear canal exits into the skull. Locate the right external auditory meatus.

chapters.title: Locate the foramen magnum.
chapters.prompt: The foramen magnum is a large hole at the base of the skull where the spinal cord meets up with the brain. Locate the foramen magnum.

chapters.title: Check your understanding of bone markings.
chapters.hint: Look at your Bone Markings vocabulary list!

chapters.title: Find the opening for the optic nerve.
chapters.prompt: The optic nerve passes through the sphenoid through the optic canal. Locate the left optic canal.

chapters.title: Battle's Sign
chapters.prompt: Battle's sign refers to the bruising behind the ear from head trauma. This typically occurs at the mastoid process. Locate the right mastoid process

chapters.title: Identify the mandible.
chapters.prompt: Mastication, or the process of eating, is done with the upper and lower jaw. The lower jaw is called the mandible. Locate the mandible.

chapters.title: Identify the maxilla.
chapters.prompt: Now locate the upper jaw. This is composed of the left and right maxillary bones. Identify the right maxillary bone.
